title: Layers of Youth Digital Safety
description: Five layers, bottom to top, and who manages each one.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given one of the five youth-safety layers a club configures, the learner classifies what risk it addresses and whether the club or a family manages it.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Click any layer for what risk it addresses and who manages it
pedagogical.assessment: Given a described risk, name the layer that addresses it.
